genetic_situation: No common SNP in the amplicon
Only one common SNP in the amplicon
hrm_solution: Sometimes it is possible to distinguish directly the three groups (Figure 1)Otherwise, spike-in or unlabelled probe is needed (Figure 2)

genetic_situation: Two SNPs in the amplicon, one is common the other is rare
hrm_solution: Spike-in when possible (Figure 3); otherwise, use unlabeled probe for the common SNP, and perform mutation scanning for the rare one (Figure 4)

genetic_situation: Two or more common SNPs in the amplicon
hrm_solution: Use an unlabeled probe for each SNP (Figure 5)

genetic_situation: Two SNPs in two different amplicons
hrm_solution: When Tm of 2 amplicons is different, it is possible to perform multiplex PCR (Figure 6)
